In addition to automatic metrics, we perform human evaluation on two of the tasks to assess the abilities of our All Tasks MT conversational agent: the knowledge grounding task Wizard of Wikipedia (WoW) and the image grounding task Image Chat. We follow the same evaluation protocols as in ; , comparing our method to the existing approaches referenced in Table . This involves collecting 100 human-bot conversations for WoW using crowdworkers, involving 8-10 turns each, across seen topics (seen in the training set) and unseen topics, and 500 image-based responses for Image Chat. A separate set of crowdworkers are then used to compare models pairwise following the ACUTE-Eval procedure of , where they are asked to choose which is 'the more engaging response' for Image Chat (1500 trials) and 'Who would you prefer to talk to for a long conversation?' for WoW (400 trials).
